basic_info.description: Sensational opportunity to own a semi-detached, three-bedroom, two-bath Mid-century home in a prime Portola district location! The upper-level of the home has two spacious bedrooms that overlook the garden and view, a large eat-in kitchen, a full bathroom, and a formal living room with fireplace. The lower-level of the property has an additional living space with separate access, fireplace, wet-bar, full bathroom and opens directly to the garden/backyard/patio. The garage provides plenty of room for storage and side by side parking for two cars. Do not miss this special opportunity to purchase a Portola home that is located near shops, cafes, restaurants, grocery stores, McLaren Park, Palega recreation center, public transportation, HWY 101/280 and more!
